title: Advanced Marfey's
author: Jaclyn Winter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8f6htre

steps.title: Acid hydrolysis of peptide
steps.instruction: Place 300 µg peptide in 600 µL 6 M HCl, seal in a thick‑walled reaction vessel, stir and heat at 100 °C for 24 h; then evaporate to dryness under N₂.

steps.title: Divide hydrolysate for derivatization
steps.instruction: Redissolve the dried hydrolysate and split it into three equal portions of 100 µg each for subsequent derivatization (L‑FDAA, D‑FDAA, and GITC).

steps.title: Derivatize with L‑ and D‑FDAA
steps.instruction: For each of the two 100 µg aliquots, add 100 µL 1 M NaHCO₃ and 100 µL 1 % l‑FDAA (or d‑FDAA) solution in acetone; incubate at 40 °C for 1 h, then neutralize with 100 µL 1 M HCl, dilute with 100 µL MeCN, filter through a 0.45 µm PTFE membrane, and analyse by HPLC‑DAD‑MS (Phenomenex Prodigy ODS‑2, 250 × 4.6 mm, 5 µm, 0.7 mL min⁻¹, gradient 90 % H₂O/MeCN → 100 % MeCN with 0.1 % formic acid over 45 min, 340 nm UV, positive/negative ion mode).

steps.title: Prepare FDAA amino‑acid standards
steps.instruction: Dissolve each l‑amino acid (Ala, Val, Ser, Leu, Ile, allo‑Ile, Phe, Pro, Gln, Glu, Thr, allo‑Thr, Cys) to 50 mM in 50 µL H₂O, add 20 µL 1 M NaHCO₃ and 100 µL 1 % l‑ or d‑FDAA in acetone, incubate at 40 °C for 1 h, quench with 20 µL 1 M HCl, dilute with 810 µL MeCN, and analyse under the same HPLC conditions as above.

steps.title: Derivatize with GITC
steps.instruction: Take a 100 µg hydrolysate aliquot, add 50 µL 6 % triethylamine and 50 µL 1 % GITC solution in acetone, incubate at room temperature for 20 min, quench with 50 µL 5 % acetic acid, dry under N₂, redissolve in 50 µL MeOH, and analyse by HPLC‑DAD‑MS (same column, flow 0.7 mL min⁻¹, gradient 90 % H₂O/MeCN → 30 % H₂O/MeCN over 45 min, 0.1 % formic acid, 254 nm UV, positive/negative ion mode).

steps.title: Prepare GITC amino‑acid standards
steps.instruction: Prepare 50 mM solutions of each l‑ and d‑amino acid (Ala, Leu, Ile, allo‑Ile, Pro, Glu) in 50 µL H₂O, add 10 µL 6 % triethylamine and 20 µL 1 % GITC, incubate at room temperature for 20 min, quench with 10 µL 5 % acetic acid, and analyse by the same HPLC method as the GITC‑derivatized hydrolysate.

steps.title: Optimized HPLC for Leu/Ile/allo‑Ile
steps.instruction: Re‑run the GITC‑derivatized samples and standards using an optimized gradient: 0.7 mL min⁻¹ flow, 70 % H₂O/MeCN → 60 % H₂O/MeCN with 0.1 % formic acid over 80 min, to achieve satisfactory resolution of Leu, Ile and allo‑Ile.
